says: Level.sev1Fix keeps a named sev1 fix while any issue its fix line lists is open, and Incident.fix lists every open ci-scheduled issue, so a long-lived issue such as the speed issue keeps a fix named for later issues.
proof: Run on the head: with a fix line {branch: fabrikalfa/x, issues: [1333, 1700]}, sev1Fix(entries, [1333, 1800]) (1700 closed, new 1800 open, 1333 still open) returns fabrikalfa/x. Level.ts:112-114 says a fix named for a closed issue is not the fix of one that opened after it. GitHub: issue 1333 was created 2026-11-15T20:40:17Z and is still open.
cost: land.ts merge --admin passes the sev1 route for a branch that answered an earlier issue; the other gates still apply, but one fix stays named and blocks naming the next until a drop.
